nodes.description: Public function post(string calldata content) that emits the NewPost event with msg.sender and the supplied content.
Calldata string parameter content passed to post; forwarded verbatim into the emitted event.
Caller-controlled address used as the indexed user argument of the NewPost event.
emit NewPost(msg.sender, content) side-effect operation that publishes an arbitrary string together with the caller address as a log entry.

edges.reason: The calldata parameter content flows directly into the event payload emitted by NewPost.
msg.sender flows directly into the indexed user field of the emitted NewPost event.
Execution of post unconditionally reaches the emit statement; there is no branching, guard or access control.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter content is a local-only input of post and has no independent semantic identity outside that function, so it is normalized into the enclosing core function node.
